prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE full-body transparent visual novel game sprite by editing the supplied original project NAI master. Preserve EXACT same face proportions, eye color, hair silhouette/parting/accessories, costume, trim/buttons, socks/shoes and body proportions. Match its crisp variable ink contours, patterned hard cel shadows and subdued palette; no redesign or soft airbrush. New acting C09: flustered attempt to explain, uneven nervous mouth, one hand open to stop interruption, small sweat mark.  Entire body, top hair and both shoes inside empty transparent safe margins. One character only, anatomically correct hands. No scenery, glow, vignette, cast shadow, lettering, logos or furniture. Retain EVERY existing worn accessory, equipment, belt attachment and tool from the master. Do not add duplicate accessories or new held tools, weapons, fire or magic. Genuine transparent alpha outside silhouette. Portrait 1024x1536.  Character temperament: Polite authority and social control: deliberate calming or ordering palms, clipboard handled firmly; smiles can be strained and cold rather than universally warm.
origin: one NAI master per character; does not use rejected NAI pose candidates
